data.exact_reserve_text: The 2017 net technical result of GBP 43.7m (2016: GBP 35.6m) includes GBP 51.2m (2016: GBP 40.4m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a net technical result of GBP 43.7m for 2017, which included GBP 51.2m of net releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years. This net release was attributed to better actual experience compared to expected, leading to reserve redundancies on old years of account. However, a detailed analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a gross strengthening of GBP 71.388m for prior underwriting years, suggesting that while the net position was favourable, the gross claims estimates for older years increased.
